behavioral_metrics.unique_field_sum_semantics: Sums of unique_* fields across IP rows must not be interpreted as global distinct counts.
behavioral_metrics.event_count_reconciliation: When the complete event population is available, the sum of per-IP event_count must reconcile to the source event population.

first_seen.semantic: Earliest observed event timestamp for the source_ip.

last_seen.semantic: Latest observed event timestamp for the source_ip.

dominant_attack_type.behavior: Preserve the observed dominant attack classification when available.

mitre_technique.analytics_usage: Not part of the core attacker-IP classification unless explicitly present in source data.

mitre_stage.analytics_usage: Not part of the core attacker-IP classification unless explicitly present in source data.

network_and_attribution.behavior: These fields are descriptive network or attribution metadata and must not be interpreted as MITRE fields.

geoip.missing_behavior: Missing GeoIP or ASN values remain empty/null and must not be inferred or fabricated.

source_ip.behavior: Every output row must have a valid source_ip.

timestamp.behavior: Source events used to calculate first_seen and last_seen require valid timestamps.

independence_rules: ATTACKER_IP_ANALYTICS must not modify source events.
ATTACKER_IP_ANALYTICS must not fabricate missing attacker IP attributes.
ATTACKER_IP_ANALYTICS must not infer MITRE techniques or MITRE stages.
ATTACKER_IP_ANALYTICS must not treat dominant_attack_type as a MITRE mapping.
ATTACKER_IP_ANALYTICS must not interpret sums of unique_* fields as global distinct counts.
ATTACKER_IP_ANALYTICS must not generate ML features.
ATTACKER_IP_ANALYTICS must not perform feature scaling.
ATTACKER_IP_ANALYTICS must not alter production cluster assignments.
deferred_rules: Historical 8C row counts are validation references and are not assumed to be current runtime counts.
Current execution remains DEFERRED until the actual current event output is validated against the required source_ip and timestamp fields.
Optional behavioral, attack, attribution, GeoIP, and ASN fields must only be populated when actually present in the current source data.
Missing current fields must not be reconstructed from historical 8C data.

availability.reason: The historical 8C-2 schema is defined, but current Real ELK/ML event availability for all required and optional attacker-IP dimensions has not yet been validated.
availability.activation_condition: Validate current event-level source_ip and timestamp availability, then validate which per-IP behavioral and enrichment fields are actually supported.
